articles._summary: The Russell 2000 opened the second half of 2026 pinned near a record around 3,000, going almost nowhere since the first half closed. Underneath that flat tape, seven small caps ripped 28% or more in just four trading sessions. The index, as tracked by the iShares Russell 2000 ETF (NYSE: IWM ) , is coming off a 22% first-half gain, its best opening six months since 1991. articles._summary: A year ago, a mainstream PC memory kit cost about $75. Today, the same kit can sell for as much as $460. The easy explanation would be another chip shortage. Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron control the vast majority of the global DRAM market, giving the three companies enormous influence over where memory production goes.

articles.summary: SPMO ETF is on pace for its worst month since 2015, down 10.54%. Micron and a memory-chip selloff drove it.
articles._summary: The S&P 500’s momentum strategy has beaten the market for a decade by doing one thing: buying whatever is already winning. In July, that same strategy handed it the worst month in its history. Over that same decade, the ETF is still up more than 470% from inception, a run that turned a niche factor bet into a $20.93 billion fund. Momentum investing is simple to describe.
articles._zh_headline: 美光、闪迪刚刚打破了贸易势头：SPMO 面临有史以来最糟糕的一个月
articles._zh_summary: 十年来，标普 500 指数的动量策略一直领先于市场，因为它做了一件事：买入任何已经获胜的股票。 7 月，同样的策略让它遭遇了历史上最糟糕的一个月。在同一十年中，该 ETF 较成立之初仍上涨了 470% 以上，这一举动将利基因素押注变成了 209.3 亿美元的基金。动量投资很容易描述。
